newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Arms found hidden at Kuwaiti oil terminal-paper.
newsitem.headline: Arms found hidden at Kuwaiti oil terminal-paper.

text.p: Weapons and ammunition were found hidden at Kuwait's crude oil and refined products export terminal of Mina al-Ahmadi, al-Rai al-Aam newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The daily said the weapons were not related to the 1990-91 Gulf crisis and were recently placed there "for later use".
The newspaper quoted "informed sources" as saying in a front-page report that the uncovered arms included hand grenades and rocket-propelled grenades.
"The sources said that the arms were very carefully stored" in a room at Ahmadi port which also has a 440,000 barrel per day refinery.

"The method of storing does not indicate that the weapons were left behind after the (1990) Iraqi invasion (of Kuwait) but indicates that they were recently placed at the port ... and stored for later use," the newspaper added.
